city.Timor-Leste.landmark: Cristo Rei statue on a headland above Dili's blue bay and beaches
city.Timor-Leste.greeting: In Tetum, people greet with “Bondia” (good morning) — and many just say “Olá” (oh-LAH), borrowed from Portuguese.
city.Timor-Leste.flag: a black triangle, a yellow arrow, and a white star on a red background

city.Yemen.description: This country sits at the tip of the Arabian Peninsula in the Middle East. It is known for ancient tower-houses made of mud brick, its link to the legendary Queen of Sheba, and pricey wild honey.
city.Yemen.landmark: surreal umbrella-shaped dragon's blood trees on the rocky hills of Socotra Island
city.Yemen.greeting: In Arabic, hello is “Salaam” (sah-LAAM), short for “As-salamu alaykum.”
city.Yemen.flag: pinned on a flag badge: three simple stripes of red, white, and black
city.Yemen.clue.0: sketched a tall city of mud-brick towers people call the "Manhattan of the Desert"
city.Yemen.clue.1: wanted to see strange umbrella-shaped "dragon's blood" trees on a faraway island
city.Albania.description: This mountainous country sits on the Balkan coast of Southeast Europe, across the sea from Italy. Locals call it the "Land of the Eagles," and thousands of little round concrete bunkers still dot its hills.
city.Albania.landmark: stacked white Ottoman houses of Berat climbing the hillside above the river
city.Albania.greeting: In Albanian, hello is “Përshëndetje” (per-shen-DET-yeh), or just “Tung” for short.
city.Albania.flag: bright red with a black two-headed eagle in the middle
city.Albania.clue.0: kept calling their next stop the "Land of the Eagles"
city.Albania.clue.1: was curious about the thousands of tiny round concrete bunkers scattered across a country's hills
city.Albania.clue.2: swapped travelers' cheques for a roll of lek before packing
city.Andorra.description: This tiny country is tucked high in the Pyrenees mountains between France and Spain. It has no army, is a favorite spot for skiing, and shoppers flock in for its duty-free bargains.
city.Andorra.landmark: snowy Pyrenees mountain village with ski slopes and a stone Romanesque bell tower
city.Andorra.flag: studied a flag in a guidebook: blue, yellow, and red stripes with a little crest in the middle
city.Andorra.clue.0: traced the winding mountain road to a tiny country wedged high between France and Spain
city.Andorra.clue.1: packed skis and warm gear, excited to swoosh down snowy Pyrenees slopes
city.Andorra.clue.2: planned a big shopping spree in a place famous for cheap, tax-free bargains
city.Andorra.clue.3: practiced a few words of Catalan, the local language of this tiny mountain state
city.Belarus.description: This flat, landlocked country in Eastern Europe is covered in forests, marshes, and farmland. It still has a very Soviet look in its cities and builds big, powerful tractors sent all over the world.
city.Belarus.landmark: red-brick Mir Castle reflected in its calm lake at sunset
city.Belarus.flag: doodled a red-and-green flag with a red-and-white woven pattern down one side
